Nah, but really, I've noticed some confusion among some users about when your'e supposed to use Flairs, and which Flair to use.

The following is a simplified explanation. When in doubt the Sidebar is where to go, and if necessary additional explanations can be found here.

I'll only be covering the most common Flairs in this abbreviated explanation.

[META]

All the time. Well...all the time when you want to say something unofficial, or outisde of roleplay. Want to ask the mods something? Want to ask the users something? Want to suggest something? Use this Flair.

Within the comments suggestion of a link, Meta is the best way to talk directly to a user.

If you're in a [Meta] Thread, all comments are assumed to be Meta.

[NEWS]

If you want to talk about something your nation, region, state, or tiny island has done recently. Use this Flair. Also use this to express your nations opinion outside of comments. Maintain Roleplay.

Example: "[NEWS] Liberland Urges other Countries to Support Cyrpto-Currencies" [EVENT]

If you want to talk about something your nation begins to do, is doing, or is trying to do, use this Flair.

Example: "[EVENT] Liberland Begins Archipelago Building Project"

[CONFLICT]

Example: "[CONFLICT] Liberland Begins Moving Troops to Attack Sealand"

[DIPLOMACY]

Used to make agreements, trade, research, or other, with other nations.

To accept, you need only reply as a comment.

I don't know if this will help or not, but thought it was worth a try.
